heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 10—Recording of claimed interests and rights
17A.64  Record not proof etc of existence of right etc
text: The fact that a record has been made by the Registrar under this Division that a person claims an interest in, or a right in respect of, a trade mark is not proof or evidence that the person has the right or interest claimed.
